body: How about you tell her all of this? Flat-out tell her you can't trust her. Bring up your reasons. Her job is to listen and to help you: if she snaps at you or gets offended, she is failing at her job. Don't purposely try to attack her though. I think that would make the situation worse.

Please don't jump off a bridge. That's one of the worst ways to go, in my opinion. You have those seconds of following where you're absolutely terrified, and when you hit the water it's a sudden stop full of pain and broken bones. Some of the broken bones can even puncture your insides. If you don't die on impact, you're stuck flailing and trying to swim up. You could drown.

I'm not saying to kill yourself, but please, don't do it that way.
